subject: gk
question: The Majuli festival of North-East India is celebrated on the banks of which river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lui**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Majuli Festival is celebrated in the northeast side of the country, in the state of Assam.
 
• The place to celebrate the jubilee is the bank of River Luit, which happens to have the biggest swash islet in the world.
 
• This jubilee starts on the 21st of November each time and continues to the 24th of the same month.
 
• The sub-divisional headquarters of the Majuli Island, Garmur is well known for its ethereal scenic beauty where this jubilee is observed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Majuli, for a long time, has been the artistic capital of Assam, and thus, it has a number of artistic and religious traditions, running from the 16th century.
 
• The Majuli festival showcases the traditions through the performances of the native groups and exhibitions, where the remnants of the old traditions are displayed.
